answer: Tie each agent to one seasoned credit file at a major bureau: the bureau attests, with consent, a file at least two years old with three or more trade lines, and binds it to a single agent key. A sybil farmer hits a canyon wall — fabricating 1,000 files needs 1,000 real SSNs plus two years of rented trade lines at about $200 each, roughly $200,000, and every fake file leaves a fraud trail. At its nadir, a relic credit file with no recent activity fails the freshness check, so old dormant files cannot be recycled.
